text: Goldfinch - Goldfinch Hotels Private Limited Skip to main content GOLDFINCH BENGALURU Goldfinch Bengaluru is the flagship hotel of the MRG Group. With a tasteful blend of comfort and modern design, it leaves a lasting impression on every guest. Located in the city centre, this boutique hotel is a preferred choice for both business travellers and tourists. The hotel features elegantly designed rooms spread over seven floors, offering guests a comfortable and sophisticated stay. Each room is equipped with modern amenities, ensuring a seamless experience for guests. It houses two of MRG Group’s popular restaurants—Sana-di-ge, Coastal cuisine restaurant and The Kabab Studio, Live BBQ restaurant. The hotel also features a café called G77, a spacious banquet hall for meetings or events, and a well-equipped spa for personal care and relaxation ROOMS & SUITES EXECUTIVE ROOM GOLD CLUB ROOM SUPERIOR ROOM EXECUTIVE ROOM The Executive Room is crafted for travelers who value efficiency without compromising on relaxation.
